# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

MUGENRO is committed to providing a professional, respectful, and constructive environment for everyone participating in the development of Education Platform.

We expect all contributors, maintainers, users, and collaborators to interact professionally and in good faith.

---

## Expected Behavior

Participants are expected to:

- Be respectful and professional.
- Communicate clearly and constructively.
- Welcome different perspectives and technical opinions.
- Focus criticism on ideas, code, implementations, and decisions rather than individuals.
- Provide useful and actionable feedback.
- Respect project maintainers and contributors.
- Take responsibility for mistakes and correct them when possible.
- Prioritize the quality, security, and long-term sustainability of the project.

---

## Unacceptable Behavior

The following behavior is not acceptable:

- Harassment or discrimination.
- Personal attacks.
- Threats or intimidation.
- Deliberate disruption of project activities.
- Trolling or intentionally hostile behavior.
- Publishing private or sensitive information without permission.
- Malicious use of project infrastructure.
- Deliberate introduction of security vulnerabilities.
- Abuse of project communication channels.
- Any behavior that creates an unsafe or hostile environment for participants.

---

## Technical Disagreements

Technical disagreements are expected in software development.

Participants should:

- Explain their reasoning.
- Provide evidence where appropriate.
- Consider alternative approaches.
- Keep discussions focused on the technical or product problem.
- Accept final decisions made by project maintainers when consensus cannot be reached.

Disagreement is not a problem. Disrespectful behavior is.

---

## AI-Assisted Development

Education Platform follows an AI-native development approach.

AI-assisted development is allowed and encouraged when it improves productivity and software quality.

However:

- Contributors remain responsible for their submissions.
- AI-generated code must be reviewed.
- AI-generated content must be checked for accuracy.
- AI-generated code must be tested appropriately.
- Contributors must consider security and privacy implications.
- AI tools must not be used to intentionally introduce malicious or harmful behavior.

The use of AI does not remove the responsibility of the contributor.

---

## Reporting Violations

If you experience or observe behavior that violates this Code of Conduct, report it privately to the project maintainers.

Do not publicly escalate personal disputes through GitHub issues or pull requests.

When reporting an incident, provide:

- A description of what happened.
- Relevant context.
- Links or references when available.
- Any additional information that may help the maintainers understand the situation.

Reports will be reviewed as appropriate.

---

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may take appropriate action when this Code of Conduct is violated.

Possible actions include:

- Requesting a change in behavior.
- Removing inappropriate content.
- Closing discussions or issues.
- Restricting participation.
- Temporarily or permanently removing access to project resources.

The response will depend on the severity and circumstances of the violation.

---

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to project repositories, issues, pull requests, discussions, documentation, and other official project communication spaces operated by MUGENRO.

---

## MUGENRO

MUGENRO believes that strong software is built through clear thinking, responsible engineering, respectful collaboration, and continuous improvement.

> **Build. Automate. Evolve.**
